description: CLI output names the corpora searched, per-corpus result counts, how to expand the search (--all / --type / --limit), and provenance (provider + path/id) on every hit. A stable --json shape supports scripting.

requirements.title: Human-friendly query output
requirements.description: Default CLI query output lists which corpora were searched, the count per corpus, expansion hints, and provenance on each hit. Degraded providers are called out.

validation.notes: Rendered output contains corpora-searched list, per-corpus counts, expansion hints, and per-hit provenance.

requirements.title: Stable --json shape
requirements.description: query --json emits a stable, documented JSON structure (groups, ranked, corpora_searched, degraded, latency_ms) suitable for scripting and downstream agents.

validation.notes: --json output validates against the documented schema and round-trips the same hits as the human view.
